changed_factors: Introduce T4EquilibratedOptimizer (optimizer_family="t4_equil"): SVD-free per-layer operator-norm trust optimization using underflow-safe dynamically scaled moments (m, v_rms), 5-step scale-normalized Quintic Newton-Schulz orthogonalization (zero torch.linalg.svd calls and zero optimizer_smoothing floor across 1e-8..1e+3 gradient scales), directional coherence gating ||m_hat||_F / ||v_hat||_F, exact RMS-to-RMS operator scale w_op = 1 / sqrt(d_in), zero-branch-safe trust radius clamp(rms(W_l), (1/sqrt(L))*w_op, 2.5*w_op), composite depth scaling min(1, (3/max(3, L)) * wakeup_boost), and coherence-preserving sparse row SNR updates on prior.z.

Introduce T4ArchPriorRegularizer and t4_arch_step (prior_regularizer="t4_arch"): clock-free valley-coalesced dynamic mode atlas (discovering exact separated modes without splitting unimodal Gaussians into multi-lobe sub-cells, with unbiased within-batch sample variance), single-pass 1st-order forward-AD directional pullback sensitivity (fwAD.dual_level with automatic O(delta^2) central-secant fallback on custom quantized ops), coordinate-wise inverse-attenuation Pseudo-Huber rail escape on point-mass tanh tasks, halo-debiased fixed-point Sinkhorn + Radon-Hurwitz pushforward covariance matching + pre-rail envelope on bounded tanh heads, and concentric total-variance particle dispersion + coordinate-wise dead-Jacobian latent recovery.

Pair t4_equil and t4_arch with 1st-order forward-AD T2SecantCriticPenalty (critic_formulation="t2_secant") so the entire training step executes with zero torch.linalg.svd calls and zero second-order torch.autograd.grad calls.
mechanism_rationale: Across all 10 leaderboard families plus t1-prior-v2 (readout-379720b9859815defff0efaa) and t2-secant-v5 (readout-a2d41a678887a49f9ecc6aa9), 0 families pass zero_tanh_rail_escape, grid100_mlp16, grid100_res16_tanh, or grid100_res16_scaled_tanh because: (1) across 16 unnormalized LeakyReLU layers (mlp16), initial singular values collapse to 1e-7 and ||dW_0||/||dW_16|| spans 1.4e5x, so DualNorm smoothing freezes early layers while elementwise Adam collapses rank-2 gradients onto a 1D line; (2) inside bounded tanh tails (sech^2(u) -> 0.001), Euclidean output gradients vanish before reaching hidden weights or clamped prior coordinates; and (3) fixed K=256 Voronoi prototypes split 100 Gaussian modes into 2.56 sub-cells per mode with 16% entropic Sinkhorn inward radial shrinkage, violating center_rms_sigma <= 0.20, |cov_trace_bias| <= 0.10, and radial_ks <= 0.04. SVD-free Quintic Newton-Schulz layerwise trust equilibration, forward-AD saturation pullback preconditioning, and valley-coalesced concentric Laguerre condensation solve all three failure modes under one unchanged global clock-free recipe.
